CustomField.formula: if(ISNULL(End_Date__c),TEXT( MONTH(Start_Date__c)) +'/' + TEXT(DAY(Start_Date__c) ) + '/' + TEXT(YEAR(Start_Date__c) ) , TEXT( MONTH(Start_Date__c)) +'/' + TEXT(DAY(Start_Date__c) ) + '/' + TEXT(YEAR(Start_Date__c) )+' - '+ TEXT( MONTH(End_Date__c)) +'/' + TEXT(DAY(End_Date__c) ) + '/' + TEXT(YEAR(End_Date__c) ) )
CustomField.label: Start Date - End Date
